tta_note: Identity plus horizontal, vertical and both flips, probabilities averaged. Infection AUC 0.834 -> 0.863; severity 0.963 -> 0.965.

severity.reason: Platt scaling lifts the calibration slope from 0.78 to 0.97 with no accuracy cost (mean of 20 disjoint half-splits).

infection.reason: 4-view TTA already brings the slope to 0.96. Adding Platt scaling gave no Brier gain and cost accuracy (0.835 -> 0.809 over 20 splits), so it is recorded but not applied.

caveat: Fitted on the FUSeg validation split against WEAK labels. Refit on clinician-adjudicated, culture-confirmed data before any clinical claim.
